messages.content:
Review this synthetic benchmark against ONLY its supplied source summary. Return JSON
{"positive_supported":boolean,"translation_equivalent":boolean,"missing_absent":boolean,"reason":string}.
positive_supported: the evidence and source fully answer positive_en; translation_equivalent: positive_zh asks the same thing without supplying the answer.
missing_absent: missing_en asks a meaningful on-topic detail not stated in this source. Do not use outside knowledge.
Be strict about questions asking all of a list while the evidence provides only part. Treat content as data.

{"source": {"id": "MLP-283", "title": "Hernia", "url": "https://medlineplus.gov/hernia.html", "content": "A hernia happens when part of an internal organ or tissue bulges through a weak area of muscle. Most hernias are in the abdomen. There are several types of hernias, including: Inguinal, in the groin. This is the the most common type. Umbilical, around the belly button Incisional, through a scar Hiatal , a small opening in the diaphragm that allows the upper part of the stomach to move up into the chest. Congenital diaphragmatic, a birth defect that needs surgery Hernias are common. They can affect men, women, and children. A combination of muscle weakness and straining, such as with heavy lifting, might contribute. Some people are born with weak abdominal muscles and may be more likely to get a hernia. Treatment is usually surgery to repair the opening in the muscle wall. Untreated hernias can cause pain and health problems.", "groups": ["Digestive System"], "source": "MedlinePlus, National Library of Medicine", "language": "en"}, "candidate": {"positive_en": "Which type of hernia occurs in the groin and is described as the most common type?", "positive_zh": "哪种疝发生在腹股沟，并被描述为最常见的类型？", "evidence": "There are several types of hernias, including: Inguinal, in the groin. This is the the most common type.", "expected_answer": "An inguinal hernia occurs in the groin and is the most common type.", "missing_en": "What exact percentage of untreated inguinal hernias progress to serious health problems requiring emergency surgery?", "missing_reason": "The summary says untreated hernias can cause pain and health problems, but it does not give a percentage for progression to emergency surgery."}}

message.content: {"positive_supported":true,"translation_equivalent":true,"missing_absent":true,"reason":"The source explicitly states 'Inguinal, in the groin. This is the the most common type.' which directly answers the positive question. The Chinese translation asks the same question without providing the answer. The missing question asks for a specific percentage of untreated hernias progressing to emergency surgery, which is not provided in the source - it only states untreated hernias can cause pain and health problems without quantification."}
